groupTitle: Nike Phoenix Fleece High Rise Wide Pants - Women's

model.name: Nike Phoenix Fleece High Rise Wide Pants - Women's
model.description:
Cinch up the Nike Phoenix Fleece High Rise Wide Pants to navigate through your day with ease. Stitched with two-way stretch fabric, these high-waisted pants deliver comfort that moves with you. The elastic waistband with a drawcord brings customisable coverage to this invincible mix. Bold, breezy, and effortlessly chic, the Nike Phoenix Fleece High Rise Wide Pants keep you ready for whatever the day has in store for you.

Nike Phoenix Fleece High Rise Wide Pants features:

  • Side vents offer comfort.
  • Pockets provide space to stash small items.
  • Pocket type: External.
  • Machine wash.
  • 80% cotton/20% polyester. Imported.
